subject.title: fix: keep the global loop breaker reachable after tool blocks

question: Should detector-generated vetoes use this PR's typed `loop-veto` outcome or the sentinel result-hash approach in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109619?
rationale: Both branches target the same issue and have positive proof, but they establish different internal state contracts; landing both is unsafe, and selecting the permanent representation belongs to the feature owner.

options.title: Land the typed outcome
options.body: Rebase and land this PR because its closed outcome representation avoids a semantic hash sentinel and explicitly preserves reset-after-progress behavior.

options.title: Land the sentinel alternative
options.body: Close this PR and use the parallel branch only if maintainers prefer keeping the session record shape unchanged and accept the sentinel contract.

recommendation.title: Land the typed outcome
recommendation.body: Rebase and land this PR because its closed outcome representation avoids a semantic hash sentinel and explicitly preserves reset-after-progress behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work introduced the current detector-veto behavior and tests that this change extends.
